title: Over 500 princely states joined India
sources: NCERT Class 12, Politics in India since Independence, ch. 1
V. P. Menon, The Story of the Integration of the Indian States (1956)

quiz.q: Which three subjects did the Instrument of Accession first cover?
quiz.why: Right. Defence, external affairs and communications.

lines.say: At independence, over 500 princely states had to choose.

beats.say: At independence, over 500 princely states had to choose. Almost all joined India peacefully.

lines.say: Sardar Patel led it as Home Minister,
with V. P. Menon as secretary of the States Ministry.

beats.say: Sardar Patel led it as Home Minister, with V. P. Menon as secretary of the States Ministry.

lines.say: Junagadh joined after a plebiscite in 1948.
Hyderabad was integrated after police action in September 1948.

beats.say: Junagadh joined after a plebiscite in 1948. Hyderabad was integrated after police action in September 1948.

lines.say: Rulers signed an Instrument of Accession,
first ceding only defence, external affairs and communications.

data.text: The Instrument of Accession: defence, external affairs and communications.
